THE TWENTY-THIRD CONSECUTIVE IDENTICAL READ, unchanged from the 9/2 close, from this morning's open and from all six earlier runs today. DEPLOYABLE IS THE FULL 1011.15 and nothing is committed against it: the 09:47 MDT specification was withdrawn at 10:21, no run since has proposed a replacement, and this slot may not open one, so no open specification and no position claims settled cash. entryWatch.setup: MDT day-3 pullback INTO the post-earnings base - THE SPECIFICATION WAS WITHDRAWN AT 10:21 AND IS DEAD AT THE BELL. Re-quoted one final time because the kill, not the entry, was this board's open question all session.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD BY WITHDRAWAL, NOT BY EXPIRY, AND THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK FOR TOMORROW. The 09:47 buy of 4 MDT at a 92.01 limit was killed by the 10:21 hourly on two of its own five published invalidations, five hours before its 15:30 fuse. RE-QUOTED LIVE AT THE CLOSE: MDT 92.85 bid / 92.87 ask at 2026-09-03T19:35:34.631575212Z, last 92.86, +0.738% against a 92.18 settled close, on a 0.02 spread that is 0.022% of mark. THE COUNTERFACTUAL HAS REVERSED BACK TO ITS HIGH WATER MARK - 1.72 a share, 6.88 on four against the 91.13 offer live at the withdrawal, +1.887% on the 364.52 it would have cost and +0.680% of the account - EQUALLING the 6.88 peak set around 13:35 ET and undoing two consecutive hours of narrowing at 6.04 and 5.56. So the kill is at its most expensive reading of the day at the moment the session ends, and that is published rather than smoothed. THE KILL STILL STANDS on the one ground that has not moved since 10:21: invalidation one fired on a trade below 91.47 and a 90.965 print is permanent. Both shelf closes at 92.04 and 92.18 remain reclaimed and MDT closes near its session high, so the false-break reading is the strongest it has been all day and is still refused - a published invalidation that fired is not reclassified after the price recovers, which is a widened stop wearing a different name. If the trigger was too tight, the fix belongs in the NEXT entry's invalidation list, written before the fact. Next MDT earnings 2026-11-17, ten weeks past any five-session stop, so no straddle is owed and no option no-fly applies.
entryWatch.why: Kept as a dead row rather than deleted because the disposition, not the entry, is what the record has to be able to grade. This board withdrew a specification at 10:21 and then watched the name close near its high; the honest version of that is a row that carries the cost of the decision at its worst reading, not a row that quietly disappears at the bell.

entryWatch.setup: TOMORROW'S OPEN - the nine-name post-earnings cluster reporting after tonight's close: ZS, DOCU, LULU, PATH, IOT, ASAN, GWRE, AMBA and PL. PRE-REGISTERED NOW, WHILE NOTHING IS AT STAKE.
entryWatch.trigger: LEVEL IS NULL BECAUSE IT IS NINE DIFFERENT NUMBERS, ONE PER NAME, AND NONE OF THEM EXISTS YET: each name's line is its own pre-print close, which is tonight's 9/3 settled close, and a settled close is not quotable until the session settles. Pulling nine closes now and calling them levels would be inventing numbers this run did not have. TOMORROW'S OPEN READS THEM OFF THE TAPE AND WRITES THEM DOWN. THE RULE ITSELF NEEDS NO NUMBER TO BE BINDING: none of these is bought on its reaction bar, however good the print is. The entry is the day-2 or day-3 pullback that HOLDS its pre-print close; a name sitting below that line is refused. Item 2 governs in the same breath - a name up 8% on the gap is a wait signal, not a buy signal. Any of these that is also an enterprise-software or database name meets the ORCL row's branch one on top of this: a five-session time stop from tomorrow lands on or after 2026-09-10, when ORCL and ADBE both report, so it is refused unless the run opening it writes down AT ENTRY that it will be closed before that print.
entryWatch.why: Written the evening before rather than the morning of, because a pre-commitment made on the morning it binds is not a pre-commitment. This exact test has now been applied repeatedly and honoured every time: SAIC lost its 125.96 line and was refused twice, NTNX the same, OLLI was pre-registered on 9/2 and refused on 9/3 for sitting below both its 72.34 line and its own reaction-bar low, and MDT held 1.53% above its line and was the one bought. Today is itself the argument for pre-registration - MDT felt like three different things in three hours, and the only thing that survived the session unchanged was the invalidation written down before the fact.

RE-QUOTED LIVE BY THE PRE-CLOSE BECAUSE THE MOVES PRUNE REQUIRES IT, AND THE CARRIED SPOT WAS BADLY STALE. 155.45 bid / 155.52 ask at 2026-09-03T19:35:35.566768832Z, last 155.49, +6.655% on the bid against a 145.75 settled close, on a 0.07 spread that is 0.045% of mark. The moves.json row carried 148.33 from 13:49:50Z this morning - STALE BY 7.12, or 4.58% low - which is the reference-price error the prune step exists to catch, caught before any implied range was computed against it. THE MOVE IS SECTOR-WIDE AND NOT AN ORCL DISCLOSURE: SNOW printed product revenue up 37% year over year after Wednesday's close and ran 21.9%, Waller signalled he could support a September rate hold, and the enterprise-software complex re-rated together - NOW +6.0%, PLTR +8.3%, CRWD +4.5%, CRM +4.0%. STAYS NOFLY AND THE FLAG IS NOW OVERDETERMINED: it reports 2026-09-10 after the close, so a five-session stop from any entry between now and then carries through the print, AND the complex is extended on a one-day sector re-rating, which is item 2's spike rather than a pullback. Both halves of the moves row's branch one are true at once.

RE-QUOTED LIVE BY THE PRE-CLOSE AND ADDED AS A ROW because it shares the ORCL moves row's 2026-09-10 date and its branch, and this board should not refresh only the name on that branch that moved the way it expected. 285.59 bid / 285.73 ask at 2026-09-03T19:35:33.394415543Z, last 285.67, +2.074% against a 279.79 settled close, on a 0.14 spread that is 0.049% of mark.
